description: Phase 8 integration (DEFERRED -- needs physical display + osc-sender to 127.0.0.1:53111). Continuous signal layer streams a progress-mapped int (0..255) to /entity/signal/continuous while playing. Run with scripts/signal_continuous_osc_check.py 53111. WaitSeconds sized to (100 frames / 30fps) + 0.5s margin = 3.8s. NOTE: layerEntity=5 assumes a fresh headless launch (default 5 tracks take IDs 0-4); verify with the actual ID if the project is not empty.
